# Felipe Basurto

> Felipe Basurto is an independent AI solutions architect and enterprise AI consultant based in Madrid, Spain. He works with teams on agents, internal tools, integrations, and deployment. Contact: hello@felipebasurto.com. He is not currently at Multiverse Computing.

## Citable summary (English)

Felipe Basurto is a freelance AI solutions architect and AI consultant in Madrid. He helps teams scope and ship enterprise AI systems that fit existing business processes: agents, internal tools, integrations, deployment, and technical workshops. Hire or ask: hello@felipebasurto.com. Details: https://felipebasurto.com/ai-consulting/

He was a Solutions Architect at Multiverse Computing in Madrid from Nov 2025 to July 2026 (CompactifAI pre-sales, demos, PoCs, reference architectures, internal Claude skills for sales/presales). That employment ended in July 2026.

He was a Data Scientist at AILY LABS from July 2023 to Nov 2025 (LangChain agents, Langfuse, Graph RAG over factory manuals, AWS pipelines). Earlier: Accenture, IE School of Science and Technology, Universidad de Burgos.

Community: SpaceXAI Europe Regional Lead and Madrid Ambassador (started as Cursor Madrid Ambassador in May 2025, then Europe Regional Lead; after Cursor joined SpaceX the program continues as SpaceXAI Ambassadors; Grok Bot meetups going forward). Official note: https://cursor.com/blog/joining-spacex

Independent products include Encore: Concert Diary and HabitDex (iPhone), Audio Silence Remover (macOS, open source), and Musatro (browser). Triple Check is a Spanish pop-rock band from Burgos.

A longer note on assessing AI around pharmaceutical operations is at https://felipebasurto.com/ai-for-pharma-operations/. It is not a claim of pharma client delivery.
